## Checklist

- [ ] PR title follows Conventional Commits
- [ ] Tests added or updated (or explained why not)
- [ ] Docs updated (README, `.env.example`, CLAUDE.md) if behaviour or setup changed
- [ ] ADR added in `docs/adr/` if this is an architectural decision
- [ ] No secrets, tokens or personal data committed
- [ ] Security impact considered (auth, input validation, data exposure, LGPD)
- [ ] Breaking change? Marked with `!` and described below
